sentences.en: The server farm suffered extensive breakage after the earthquake.
sentences.zh: 地震后，服务器农场遭受了广泛的损坏。

sentences.en: The breakage goes from the ankle to the knee. It's like the bone just disintegrated.
sentences.zh: 从脚踝到膝盖的骨头都断了。感觉就像骨头完全碎裂了一样。

sentences.en: Any more breakage and you'll never curate a blown glass exhibit in this town again!
sentences.zh: 再有任何破损的话，你就再也别想在这个城市策划吹制玻璃展览了！
